comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/audit_census.py, recorded on the 2026-10-13 audit-fix session tree (upstream base 7e94441). Counts come from THIS tool's stripping rules (comments and string literals removed, everything after the first top-level #[cfg(test)] mod cut) and therefore differ slightly from the audit's own census implementation; the ratchet is about growth, not about matching that number. `ignores_all` counts #[ignore] including test modules. Lower a number only in the commit that removes the sites; never raise it to make CI green.
